# PhoneFarm Fun (phonefarm.fun)

> Factory-built Android device farm hardware from Guangzhou, China — for mobile QA, app testing, and automation labs.

## About
PhoneFarm Fun is a Guangzhou-based hardware team supplying real Android device farm boxes, motherboard clusters, multi-device lab racks, lab accessories, and custom rack solutions for B2B buyers running mobile QA and device automation workflows.

## Products
- 20-Node Android Device Farm Starter Box — entry-level QA lab chassis
- 20-Node Real Device Testing Box Pro — continuous app testing hardware
- Android Motherboard Cluster for App QA — high-density headless nodes
- 10–20 Node Multi-Device Lab Rack — customer-supplied device chassis
- 20-Node Turnkey Device Lab Bundle — integrated power, cooling, USB, network
- 20-Node Empty Chassis — expansion unit for custom builds
- 7-Port Industrial USB Hub Module
- 450W Power Supply Module
- 4-Fan Cooling Kit
- Network Kit for 20-Node Cluster
- Custom Android Device Farm Rack Solution — 40+ node quoted projects

## Services
Device lab setup and assembly, remote control workstation setup, multi-device lab management setup, large-scale lab deployment (quote), custom hardware engineering (quote), enterprise rack deployment (quote), hardware maintenance and support, sample hardware evaluation, international shipping and export.
